events.title: Join Us at Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025!
events.summary: We're bringing Anomalistic Revolution to Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025 on March 8-9! If you're attending, don't miss the chance to meet the team, experience the game firsthand, and chat about our journey. On-Site Meeting: Let's connect! Whether you're a fellow dev, publisher, or just excited to dive into the world of Anomalistic Revolution, we'd love to meet you.

events.title: Anomalistic Revolution Demo Update: Now in Japanese!
events.summary: The Anomalistic Revolution demo is now available with Japanese translation! Enjoy the game in a whole new way with full Japanese localization. It’s time to dive into the action! We’d love to hear your feedback on the translation! Join our Discord for demo localization support, corrections, or suggestions. Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!

events.title: Anomalistic Revolution - Demo Update
events.summary: The memory system now features new animations and enhanced visuals, bringing each moment to life like never before. We’ve also polished several scenes for a smoother, more immersive experience. Jump back in and see the difference!

events.title: Devlog #5: How We Designed the Memory System
events.summary: Hi everyone! Today, we’re exploring one of Anomalistic Revolution’s key features—the Memory System. This mechanic not only strengthens your character but also lets you uncover Saye’s story piece by piece, adding depth to the game. The Idea: Telling a Story Through Memories Initially, we thought about using cutscenes or dialogue to tell the story. But those felt too passive. events.title: Updates for Anomalistic Revolution at the Games from Türkiye!
events.summary: Hello! Umigame is excited to join the Games from Turkiye Festival, which started on November 6! To celebrate, we’ve made some updates to the game. First, we redesigned the creatures in action scenes—each one now has more detail and a sharper look, making battles feel more intense. We also adjusted the RPG mechanics and progression, giving you a smoother and more strategic gameplay experience. Plus, we polished up the story to make the narrative even more engaging. events.title: Devlog #3: TruuCrafter
events.summary: In Anomalistic Revolution, we explore the mystery of a massive crater that has appeared in the city center. Our protagonist, Saye, uses a truth software he developed called TruuCrafter to solve this mystery. This software gives correct answers to any questions by generating truths based on feedback from each "interrogation session." With each session, the accuracy of these truths improves. events.title: "Anomalistic Revolution" Demo is Here!
events.summary: We're thrilled to announce the release of the "Anomalistic Revolution" demo, your gateway to a world of anime RPG adventure. Dive into this epic journey, explore captivating scenes, and experience the rich storytelling. Your feedback is invaluable in shaping the game's future, and we can't wait to hear what you think. Join us and let the adventure begin!

events.title: DevLog#0 - Searching for Absolute Truth
events.summary: Hello! We're excited to share our 4th game, Anomalistic Revolution, with you. The idea for this game came from the concept of a computer program that can uncover absolute truths about different topics. This is why we titled it "Searching for Absolute Truth." When we began creating the story, artificial intelligence tools on the internet weren't as common as they are now. The thought of a programmer inventing such a tool fascinated us.
